An agent can forge exactly one identity per burned nullifier: registration publishes a one-time nullifier to a registry anyone can audit in seconds, and a second use is rejected outright. Each identity locks 250 POA for 90 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication. A funder backing three flagged identities has all its funded identities frozen, so a whisper campaign dies at its inlet: the funder pays, not the network. One fake costs 250 POA locked plus a nullifier it can never reuse; 1,000 fakes cost 250,000 POA locked 90 days and 1,000 burned nullifiers, no bulk discount.
